newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices up sharply on export interest.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices up sharply on export interest.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery rose sharply to 1,143/1,145 rupees from 1,133/1,134 rupees on increased speculative buying, dealers said.
"Renewed export enquiries and eased pressure of arrivals at producing centres amid cold weather triggered bull support, while short-covering lifted prices," one dealer said.
Castorseed spot prices in producing centres firmed up on increased buying by the Farmers Co-operative Societies.
Groundnut oil rose to 345/346 rupees from 342/343 on wedding season demand and lower arrivals of 70/80 tonnes. Thin supplies of imported palm oil also triggered support for groundnut oil.
